notes.title: Supernatural detective RPG that was removed from Steam set for 2025 release
notes.notes:
I first played Kill the Shadow at Steam Next Fest last year. Little did I know it had already won numerous indie awards in China, where independent developer Shadowlight is based. Soon after it had shot to the top of my wishlist, however, disaster struck. The supernatural detective RPG was removed from Steam, along with a string of other titles published by 663 Games. After acquiring a new publisher and a lengthy battle with Steam, the game is back on Valve's storefront, with a demo available to download now. Despite all the hardships, Kill the Shadow is still targetting a 2025 release.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Kill The Shadow x NEOWIZ Official Announcement!
notes.notes: [p]Back in January this year, [i]Kill The Shadow[/i] was unexpectedly banned on Steam. But just a few weeks ago, we finally won the appeal! The game has now been fully restored, and the demo is once again available for download and play.[/p][h2]It’s Official![/h2][p]After surviving the storm, comes a brighter path—today, we’re thrilled to officially announce our partnership with [b]NEOWIZ[/b]![/p][quote][p]NEOWIZ is the developer and publisher of [i]Lies of P[/i], and also the publisher of popular titles like [i]Skul[/i], [i]SANABI and Shape of Dreams[/i].[/p][/quote][p]With their extensive publishing experience, we’re excited to work with them to bring a more immersive Darkwater City to life in Kill The Shadow, delivering an even better experience for all players.[/p][h2]What’s Next[/h2][p]Even during our quietest days, development never stopped. After the game was unbanned, we had many in-depth discussions—and we've decided to [b]expand the game’s content[/b] and [b]raise the overall quality[/b].[/p][p]This will be our way of saying thank you to all the players who never gave up on us. We’re making [i]Kill The Shadow[/i] bigger, better, and bolder—see the detailed changes in the image below:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743565/87c3a3079497274369f0c775881e5b3e3d6cf680.png"][/img][/p][h2]Release Date？[/h2][p]Because of all the new work we're taking on, [i]Kill The Shadow[/i] will need some more time in the oven before it’s ready to be served up for everyone to taste. What’s that? You’re asking when it’ll be released?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743565/029c5d5dd998dc1ab0d2861182398c41b12a54da.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Kill The Shadow Steam Next Fest New Demo!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743565/22b38c20bca6f8431364710128a85844702b2d83.png[/img]

[h3]Hi everyone!
[/h3]
The new Steam Next Fest demo of the story-driven puzzle game "Kill the Shadow" developed by Shadowlight Sanctuary and published by 663 Games is now available. The new demo has added new scenes and storylines. Players can explore more content in it and every choice you make will affect the flow of the world line. The game will participate in the Steam Next Fest in October. You can now search for "Kill the Shadow" on the Steam platform and download the demo for free.

[h3]Watch the Official Steam Next Fest Trailer here:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=TmgrR4B_esc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]What's in the new demo?[/h3]
Other than the full storyline of Chapter 1, we have added a small bit of content from Chapter 2, and some new flashbacks and re-designed scenes! Please see below for the details:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743565/aae1491da81357936c79cdc92eb471316529dd0d.jpg[/img]

In the game, in addition to tracing the astonishing secret behind reporter Lynn's letters, players also need to restore the truth of the incident through various details hidden in conversations and even scenes. And by doing so, they can judge the stance represented by each character in the game. Through deconstruction and conjecture, players can explore the stories behind each character using the clues they have already mastered. The game has multiple endings. Every choice you make will affect the direction of the world.

In the demo version of "Kill the Shadow", players will learn part of the truth of the events by solving layer upon layer of puzzles through rigorous logical reasoning, they can also obtain a considerable sense of satisfaction. If you are interested in the game, you can add this game to your wishlist. Welcome to download the demo and try it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2660230/_/

notes.title: Kill the Shadow Demo Available Now!
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings players,[/b]

We are more than happy to announce that Kill the Shadow, a suspenseful detective role playing game set in a post-war divided city has launched its free demo on Steam! 
In this game, you will take on the role of Detective Ah Guang, using their wit, eloquence, and unique ability to revisit crime scenes through shadows (and even resort to violence) to solve mysterious cases and uncover a shocking secret.

Demo video:
[previewyoutube=UId5FaxOANk;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Hints and Evidence[/b]
Freely choose to enhance your abilities—strength, spirit, charm—and select your own methods to investigate cases—psychological warfare? Bribery? Or simply beating up suspects? Deduction System: Collect, analyze, and connect related clues to create your own unique investigation path!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743565/ffde88766a58111de4e93ca25c64962e54ea62e1.gif[/img]


[b]Seeing the Past[/b]
"The Shadow", a strange creature attached to you that reads memories and reconstructs the traces of the deceased! 
"Don't worry, Ah'Guang, we're just using each other. You use me to find the culprit, and I, well, I love tasting those bizarre stories, hahaha!", says the Shadow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743565/3f613240f7a64607890bb318237077711e4284bf.jpg[/img]

[b]The Ways of the World[/b]
Meet various characters in the city: the energetic girl with a camera, the elegant Mrs. Ruan, the rumored goddess who can cast spells, and the elderly fish-selling lady. Discover the stories behind them. Encounter characters like the self-righteous Captain Wang, Lao Citou's son Xiao Citou, the foul-mouthed Little Rascal, and the deceased Master Ruan. Earn your favorite characters' hearts by numerous events!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743565/08f0c7c427b6ef95ea156f20b6aa6931b3b7cd54.jpg[/img]

[b]Retro and Neon[/b]
The combination of 3D environments and 2D pixel characters creates a unique artistic style with a striking contrast between modern and retro. Explore a variety of diverse and freely explorable scenes: the dilapidated steel forest factory, the muddy shipwreck dock built on water, the Zhulong Walled City blending the fictional traditional Ma Island and Imperial culture, and the bustling old city district.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743565/ae4688576a827ca3b38bc46ea7d24455039dbab3.jpg[/img]

Download our demo and dive into it right now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2660230/Kill_The_Shadow/


Feel free to join our [url=discord.gg/7FmPVkrNTG]Discord [/url]for further discussion!
